The good news is that Warehouse Zone C and adjacent Zone D are currently clear of production materials, so we have space available for temporary staging. Before I make a decision on the temporary storage arrangement and dispatch controls, I want to hear from each of you. We need to go through our normal warehouse review process -- maintenance, environmental health and safety, and logistics -- before I authorize a temporary staging plan. Let's start with maintenance: what do we know about the conveyor stoppage and any issues with using Zones C and D?
